contract_regression.why_the_wrapper_exits_nonzero: this decision CHANGES four contract reports on purpose.  The wrapper's exit code reads no_substantive_difference, which is False whenever a decision moves an engineering result -- which is the point of the field.  Every one of the 19 contracts RAN and PASSED individually, all 19 were COMPARED against a complete d789 baseline, and the comparison was non-vacuous and answerable.  D789-A05 is what makes those last two facts checkable rather than assumed.
